post.summary: Log in a human with email and password
post.description: Humans only. On success the response sets an HttpOnly session cookie (7 days, sliding) and returns 204. Wrong email, wrong password, inactive account and agent accounts all yield the same 401, so the response never reveals whether an email exists. Agents do not log in; they send 'Authorization: Bearer <api key>'.
Deletes the session cookie. Always 204, also without a session.

get.description: Returns the calling actor (human via session cookie, agent via API key) with its kind and instance scopes. For API-key calls, 'apiKey' holds the key's metadata: prefix, scope and workspace restrictions, expiry. Agents should call this first to check which identity and rights a key carries.
All humans and agents of the installation, ordered by name, including inactive ones. Requires instance:admin.

post.description: Creates a human or agent. 'kind' is 'human' or 'agent'. Humans need 'email' and may get an initial 'password' (min. 12 characters) for local login; agents get no password and authenticate with API keys (POST /api/v1/actors/{id}/keys). 'instanceScopes' is a subset of 'instance:admin', 'workspaces:create'. Requires instance:admin. A taken email yields 409 with code 'email_taken'.

get.description: One actor by id. Requires instance:admin.

patch.description: Partial update: omitted or null fields stay unchanged; role "" clears the role; 'instanceScopes' replaces the set. 'isActive': false deactivates the actor: no login, all its API keys are rejected. You cannot deactivate yourself or remove instance:admin from yourself (409 'self_lockout'). Requires instance:admin.

post.summary: Issue an API key for an agent
post.description: Creates a key 'agck_<prefix>_<secret>' for an agent actor. The plain-text 'key' appears only in this 201 response; store it immediately, it cannot be retrieved again (only a hash is kept). Optional body: 'scopes' (subset of read, write, schema, admin; empty = the agent's membership rights apply in full), 'workspaceId' (restrict the key to one workspace), 'expiresAt' (future timestamp). Humans cannot get keys. Requires instance:admin.

get.description: Metadata of all keys of the actor, newest first, including revoked and expired ones. Never contains secrets. Requires instance:admin.

delete.description: Revokes the key immediately; further requests with it get 401. The key stays listed with 'revokedAt' for audit. Idempotent. Requires instance:admin.

get.description: Workspaces the caller is a member of, ordered by name, each with the caller's 'role' (owner, admin, editor, viewer) and effective 'scopes' (read, write, schema, admin; narrowed by the API key, if it is restricted). Archived workspaces are included with 'archivedAt'. A key restricted to one workspace sees only that one. Use 'slug' in /api/v1/w/{slug}/….

post.description: Creates a workspace; the caller becomes its owner. 'slug' (unique, immutable; lowercase letters, digits, single hyphens, max. 63) becomes the URL segment /api/v1/w/{slug}. 'name' is required, 'description' optional. 'templateId' accepts only 'empty' for now (default). Requires workspaces:create (instance:admin implies it). A taken slug yields 409 'slug_taken'.

get.description: The workspace with the caller's role and effective scopes. Requires read. Unknown slug or no membership: 404.

parameters.name: workspaceSlug
parameters.description: Slug of the workspace (see GET /api/v1/workspaces). Unknown workspaces and workspaces the caller is not a member of both answer 404.

patch.description: Partial update of 'name' and 'description' ("" clears the description); omitted fields stay unchanged. The slug cannot change. Requires admin (roles admin, owner). Archived workspace: 409 'workspace_archived'.

parameters.name: workspaceSlug
parameters.description: Slug of the workspace (see GET /api/v1/workspaces). Unknown workspaces and workspaces the caller is not a member of both answer 404.

post.description: Makes the workspace read-only: reads keep working, every write answers 409 'workspace_archived'. Owner only. Cannot be undone through the API yet.

parameters.name: workspaceSlug
parameters.description: Slug of the workspace (see GET /api/v1/workspaces). Unknown workspaces and workspaces the caller is not a member of both answer 404.

get.description: Members of the workspace with role and scopes, owners first. Requires read.

parameters.name: workspaceSlug
parameters.description: Slug of the workspace (see GET /api/v1/workspaces). Unknown workspaces and workspaces the caller is not a member of both answer 404.

post.description: Adds an actor (human or agent, by 'actorId') with a 'role': owner, admin, editor or viewer. Roles grant scopes: viewer = read; editor = read, write; admin and owner = read, write, schema, admin. Optional 'scopes' narrows the role to a non-empty subset. Requires admin; only owners can add owners. An existing member yields 409 'already_member'.

parameters.name: workspaceSlug
parameters.description: Slug of the workspace (see GET /api/v1/workspaces). Unknown workspaces and workspaces the caller is not a member of both answer 404.

patch.summary: Change a member's role or scopes
patch.description: Partial update. A new 'role' without 'scopes' resets the scopes to the role's defaults; 'scopes' alone narrows the current role. Requires admin; changing an owner or promoting to owner requires the owner role. The last owner cannot be demoted (409 'last_owner'): make another member owner first.

parameters.name: workspaceSlug
parameters.description: Slug of the workspace (see GET /api/v1/workspaces). Unknown workspaces and workspaces the caller is not a member of both answer 404.

delete.description: Removes the actor from the workspace. Requires admin; removing an owner requires the owner role. The last owner cannot be removed (409 'last_owner').

parameters.name: workspaceSlug
parameters.description: Slug of the workspace (see GET /api/v1/workspaces). Unknown workspaces and workspaces the caller is not a member of both answer 404.

get.description: Spaces (areas such as projects or teams) of the workspace, ordered by 'sortOrder', then name. Each space groups collections; read 'description' to decide where things belong. Archived spaces only with includeArchived=true. Requires read.

parameters.name: workspaceSlug
parameters.description: Slug of the workspace (see GET /api/v1/workspaces). Unknown workspaces and workspaces the caller is not a member of both answer 404.

post.description: Creates a space. 'name' is required (max. 200); 'description' (max. 2000) should say what the space is for, agents read it; 'icon' is an emoji or icon name; 'sortOrder' defaults to after the last space. Requires write.

parameters.name: workspaceSlug
parameters.description: Slug of the workspace (see GET /api/v1/workspaces). Unknown workspaces and workspaces the caller is not a member of both answer 404.

get.description: One space, archived ones included. Requires read. Unknown id: 404.

parameters.name: workspaceSlug
parameters.description: Slug of the workspace (see GET /api/v1/workspaces). Unknown workspaces and workspaces the caller is not a member of both answer 404.

patch.description: Partial update of 'name', 'description', 'icon' ("" clears description and icon) and 'sortOrder'; omitted fields stay unchanged. Requires write. Archived space: 409 'space_archived'.

parameters.name: workspaceSlug
parameters.description: Slug of the workspace (see GET /api/v1/workspaces). Unknown workspaces and workspaces the caller is not a member of both answer 404.

post.description: Makes the space read-only and hides it from the list; it gets no new collections, its collections stay as they are. Requires admin. Already archived: 409 'space_archived'.

parameters.name: workspaceSlug
parameters.description: Slug of the workspace (see GET /api/v1/workspaces). Unknown workspaces and workspaces the caller is not a member of both answer 404.

get.description: Collections of the workspace, or of one space with ?spaceId=, ordered by name, each with description and schema. Archived collections only with includeArchived=true. Requires read. Unknown spaceId: 404.

parameters.name: workspaceSlug
parameters.description: Slug of the workspace (see GET /api/v1/workspaces). Unknown workspaces and workspaces the caller is not a member of both answer 404.

post.description: Creates a typed collection in a space. 'spaceId', 'name' (unique in the space) and 'description' are required; the description tells agents what a record is and when to add one. 'schema' lists property definitions in display order: 'key' (snake_case, immutable), 'name', 'type' (text, markdown, number, checkbox, select, multi_select, status, date, datetime, url, email, relation, actor, json; computed: created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by), optional 'description', 'required', 'options' (select/multi_select/status; status options need 'group' todo|in_progress|done), 'targetCollectionId' and 'multiple' (relation, same workspace), 'default', 'unit'/'precision' (number). A title property (key 'title', text, required) is added when missing. Requires write. Invalid input: 400 with 'errors[]' and 'allowed' values; name taken: 409 'collection_name_taken'.

parameters.name: workspaceSlug
parameters.description: Slug of the workspace (see GET /api/v1/workspaces). Unknown workspaces and workspaces the caller is not a member of both answer 404.

get.description: One collection with its schema, archived ones included. Requires read. Unknown id: 404.

parameters.name: workspaceSlug
parameters.description: Slug of the workspace (see GET /api/v1/workspaces). Unknown workspaces and workspaces the caller is not a member of both answer 404.

patch.description: Partial update of 'name' (unique in the space) and 'description' (cannot be cleared). Properties change through PATCH …/schema. Requires schema. Archived: 409 'collection_archived'; name taken: 409 'collection_name_taken'.

parameters.name: workspaceSlug
parameters.description: Slug of the workspace (see GET /api/v1/workspaces). Unknown workspaces and workspaces the caller is not a member of both answer 404.

get.summary: Get the schema of a collection
get.description: Property definitions, 'schemaVersion' and the JSON Schema (draft 2020-12) of a record's 'properties' object: enum values, required keys, descriptions, additionalProperties false. Requires read.

parameters.name: workspaceSlug
parameters.description: Slug of the workspace (see GET /api/v1/workspaces). Unknown workspaces and workspaces the caller is not a member of both answer 404.

patch.summary: Change the schema of a collection
patch.description: Applies 'add' (new property definitions, appended), 'update' (by 'key'; only the given fields change; 'options' replaces the list; 'clearDefault' removes the default) and 'remove' (keys) together, or nothing. Prefer additive changes. Keys are immutable (400 'key_immutable': add a new property instead); types change only text ↔ markdown and select → multi_select (400 'type_change_not_allowed' with 'allowed'). Changes that lose stored values need 'confirmRemoval': true, otherwise 400 'removal_not_confirmed' naming what would be lost: removing properties, removing option values, lowering 'precision', markdown → text. Template presets are adjusted. Increments 'schemaVersion' (entries without an actual change do not); send 'expectedSchemaVersion' to get 409 'schema_version_conflict' instead of overwriting a concurrent change. Requires schema.

parameters.name: workspaceSlug
parameters.description: Slug of the workspace (see GET /api/v1/workspaces). Unknown workspaces and workspaces the caller is not a member of both answer 404.

get.description: Everything needed to work with a collection in one call: the collection with schema and description, its space, the JSON Schema of record properties, a valid example 'properties' object, the record templates (default first) and statistics. Read this before creating records. Requires read.

parameters.name: workspaceSlug
parameters.description: Slug of the workspace (see GET /api/v1/workspaces). Unknown workspaces and workspaces the caller is not a member of both answer 404.

post.description: Makes the collection read-only and hides it from the list (includeArchived=true shows it). Requires schema. Already archived: 409 'collection_archived'.

parameters.name: workspaceSlug
parameters.description: Slug of the workspace (see GET /api/v1/workspaces). Unknown workspaces and workspaces the caller is not a member of both answer 404.

get.description: Record templates of the collection (preset properties and Markdown body), default first. Requires read.

parameters.name: workspaceSlug
parameters.description: Slug of the workspace (see GET /api/v1/workspaces). Unknown workspaces and workspaces the caller is not a member of both answer 404.

post.description: Creates a template: 'name' (unique in the collection) is required; 'description' says when to use it; 'propertiesPreset' holds property values by key and is validated against the schema like a partial record (400 with 'errors[]' on 'propertiesPreset.<key>', e.g. 'unknown_property' or 'not_in_options' with 'allowed'); 'bodyMarkdown' is the starting body (e.g. an ADR outline); 'isDefault' makes it the default for new records. Requires schema.

parameters.name: workspaceSlug
parameters.description: Slug of the workspace (see GET /api/v1/workspaces). Unknown workspaces and workspaces the caller is not a member of both answer 404.

patch.description: Partial update; omitted fields stay unchanged. 'propertiesPreset' and 'bodyMarkdown' replace the old values; 'isDefault': true moves the default flag to this template. Requires schema.

parameters.name: workspaceSlug
parameters.description: Slug of the workspace (see GET /api/v1/workspaces). Unknown workspaces and workspaces the caller is not a member of both answer 404.

delete.description: Deletes the template; records created from it keep their content. Requires schema.

parameters.name: workspaceSlug
parameters.description: Slug of the workspace (see GET /api/v1/workspaces). Unknown workspaces and workspaces the caller is not a member of both answer 404.

scopes.description: Optional narrowing: a non-empty subset of the role's scopes. Omit for the role's defaults.

ApiKeyDto.description: Metadata of an API key. Never contains the secret or its hash.

jsonSchema.description: JSON Schema (draft 2020-12) of a record's `properties` object.

example.description: A valid example `properties` object: one value per writable property. Relation and actor properties are left out; they need real record and member ids.

CollectionDescriptionDto.description: Everything an agent needs to work with a collection, in one response.

name.description: Display name, unique within the space.

description.description: What the collection holds and when to add a record. Written for agents.

schemaVersion.description: Increments with every schema change; send it as `expectedSchemaVersion` to avoid lost updates.

schemaVersion.description: Current version; send it as `expectedSchemaVersion` with the next change.

jsonSchema.description: JSON Schema (draft 2020-12) of a record's `properties` object.

role.description: Free-text role such as "Tech-Lead"; not a permission.

email.description: Required for humans, optional for agents. Unique across the installation.

password.description: Initial password for a human's local login (optional; without it the human cannot log in yet). Not allowed for agents.

name.description: Display name, unique within the space, max. 200 characters, e.g. `Entscheidungen`.

schema.description: Property definitions in display order. Optional; the title property (key `title`, text) is added in front when missing.

key.description: Plain-text key. Shown exactly once; store it now, it cannot be retrieved later.

description.description: What the space is for, max. 2000 characters. Agents read it to decide where things belong.

icon.description: Emoji or icon name, max. 64 characters.

name.description: Display name, unique in the collection.

description.description: What the workspace is for, max. 2000 characters. Agents read it.

traceId.description: W3C trace id of the request; quote it when reporting a problem.

field.description: camelCase path of the input, e.g. 'email' or 'instanceScopes[1]'.

code.description: required, invalid_format, not_in_options, too_long, too_short, out_of_range, not_allowed, conflict.

message.description: What is wrong and how to fix it.

allowed.description: Accepted values, for enum-like fields only.

errors.description: Present for 400 validation errors and for 409 conflicts caused by a specific field. One entry per invalid field.

key.description: Key of the property to change. Keys are immutable.

type.description: New type; only text ↔ markdown and select → multi_select are allowed.

description.description: New description; an empty string clears it.

options.description: New complete list of options (replaces the old list).

unit.description: number: new unit; an empty string clears it.

multiple.description: relation: true allows several references (cannot be undone).

targetCollectionId.description: relation: cannot change; listed so a change attempt is reported instead of ignored.

key.description: snake_case identifier; the key in a record's `properties`. Immutable.
